policy.discovery: Broad Bloomberg/Yicai professional-hub items define the universe; causal-neighborhood hypotheses are generated only after hub detection.
policy.validation: Specialist/primary/company evidence may verify or kill a hub-triggered hypothesis but may not define the initial universe.

decisions.name: 招商南油
reasoning: Bloomberg exposed an extreme China diesel-export flow change rather than a tanker-sector screen.
S&P Global independently quantified Jan-Feb clean-product exports +171.2% and gasoil exports +1005.4%, creating an incremental seaborne product-flow driver.

Q1 company results converted the shipping cycle into earnings: attributable profit +292.7%, ex-item +281.9%, and company attributed revenue growth to high international product-tanker rates and higher foreign-trade revenue.

However, the broader MR product-tanker upcycle and the company's rate sensitivity were already well understood before the cutoff; Apr-19 research described Q1 as in line with expectations and valued 2023E at about 11x PE.
Price was deeply de-rated despite earnings: 20d/60d/120d excess versus CSI300 about -9.7/-15.9/-44.2pp.
falsifiers: China clean-product exports normalize sharply as domestic demand absorbs refinery output.
MR freight rates fall enough to offset increased operating fleet.
Company foreign-trade TCE or earnings guidance deteriorates despite the export flow.

reasoning: Bloomberg identified a real divergence: domestic trip volume exceeded 2019 while aggregate spending barely exceeded 2019, favoring throughput-linked infrastructure over spend-sensitive travel businesses.
White Cloud Airport had already returned to Q1 profitability and positive operating cash flow, making the company mapping economically credible.
But airport reopening/international-traffic recovery was already a central consensus thesis; an Apr-18 report implied about 57.8x 2023E PE.
Price absorption was not extreme, but expectation burden was too high for a hub item that mainly refined an already-known reopening thesis.
reconsiderWhen: traffic recovery materially exceeds forecasts while valuation compresses
international traffic/airport monetization resets higher than consensus

decisions.name: 华能国际
reasoning: Bloomberg's producer-deflation signal triggered a margin-transfer search rather than an electric-utility sector scan.
Physical coal validation showed Q5500 falling from roughly RMB1175/t at the start of 2023 to roughly RMB795-820/t in late June, even entering peak summer demand.
Huaneng Q1 had already shown the causal bridge: profit +335.3%, explicitly helped by lower coal prices plus higher power prices.
The recovery was already partly expected: May research used about 14x 2023E PE and the stock had strongly rerated over prior months.
At end-June, 60d/120d excess were about +10.6/+16.2pp, while 20d excess had reversed to about -7.5pp. The much larger coal-price decline is a magnitude update, not a brand-new thesis.
falsifiers: Thermal coal prices rebound materially and persist.
Power tariffs or utilization fall enough to offset fuel-cost relief.
Reported thermal-power unit margins fail to improve despite lower coal input cost.

decisions.name: 招商轮船
reasoning: Yicai broad trade coverage exposed a striking divergence: overall exports -14.5% while automobile exports +118.5%.
Causal-neighborhood reasoning followed the auto-export surge into scarce ro-ro/PCTC capacity instead of defaulting to automakers.
The H1 company report closed the company bridge: ro-ro profit RMB126m, +1304.8%, with international rentals at records and scarce slots.
The consolidated company remained inexpensive: late-Aug research implied roughly 8x 2023E PE and large target-price upside.
Price absorption at Sep-1 was modest: 20d/60d excess about +2.7/+8.7pp, with 120d excess about -13.8pp.
Ro-ro remained a minority segment, so the event could be diluted by oil/dry-bulk/container earnings.
falsifiers: PCTC charter rates or utilization fall sharply.
Ro-ro profit fails to continue expanding within consolidated earnings.

reasoning: The hub evidence supports services being relatively stronger than goods trade, but the cleanest throughput expression was already evaluated in the mobility/airport cluster.
No separate company-level absolute earnings bridge was frozen without duplicating the same reopening exposure.
Property stress is a strong risk/credit-propagation signal, but no long A-share expression with a clean absolute earnings catalyst was established.
A low-leverage or relatively safer developer would repeat the relative-winner-without-absolute-catalyst failure class seen in prior diagnostics.

The mixed domestic/external regime is useful for company-exception search but did not produce an additional independently verified company catalyst beyond the frozen auto-export and margin-transfer clusters.
Do not create another selection merely to increase annual frequency.

diagnostics.note: No minimum trade count is targeted; all seven association clusters remain in the denominator.
